result.title: Unified dynamics of training, learning, inference, and reinforcement in neural networks
result.summary: Despite their remarkable success, neural networks remain largely black boxes, and the mechanisms underlying their behavior are still poorly understood. Nine nanoGPT experiments established training-learning-inference relations: realized updates elicit state-dependent finite-amplitude responses; learning persistently reorganizes distributed functional support, with target-specific readout-boundary crossings determining capability transitions; inference recruits learned support without changing the learned state. Factors identified in the fifth experiment yielded a direct predictor of post-update capability transitions, achieving 91.43% accuracy and 91.49% four-way macro recall across 5,088 targets. We tested these relations and prediction across five additional neural architectures. In a seventh system, concentrated correct feedback eroded previously mastered skills; rebalanced feedback restored their accuracy from 70.31% to 99.48%. Linking inference consequences to subsequent training closes these relations into unified training-learning-inference-reinforcement dynamics.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文以九个 nanoGPT 实验刻画训练、学习、推理与强化反馈之间的统一动态，提出能力转变可由读出边界跨越预测，并跨多种架构检验，还展示反馈失衡导致已掌握技能退化及再平衡后的恢复。
AI.relevance_reason: 文中「推理动用已学支持但不改变学习状态」与读出边界、反馈侵蚀技能的描述，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正被更新、以及轨迹训练与 RL 反馈的贡献分配提供线索。
